title: At The Drowned Nave, 'say what you learned of the flood' sits in the same menu as three grief-resolving actions (ring the bell / speak Halm's confession / promise a tithe, each tagged '(settles this hold's grief)') but carries no such tag itself and only prints flavor text ('The singing doesn't stop') with no progress. Easy to mistake for a fourth resolution.
